notes.changed: {{app}} changed this skill. Agents won't use it until you approve the new version.
notes.dynamic: This skill is generated each time it's used, so Paperclip can't check its content. It isn't offered to agents.
notes.tooLarge: This skill is bigger than apps can rely on (512 files or 16 MiB), so it isn't offered to agents.
notes.invalid: This skill's listing doesn't follow the MCP skills format, so it isn't offered to agents.
notes.verificationFailed: {{app}} sent files that didn't match what it listed, so Paperclip stopped using this skill. Refresh the app to see its current version.

heading: Skills from connected apps
approvalNote: Agents that use an app get its skills only after you approve them.
nameCollision: Another skill uses this name. Agents get this one under {{app}}'s name, so neither replaces the other.
approvingNote: Approving lets agents that use {{app}} follow these instructions, including commands they describe.
loadFailed: Couldn't load skills from connected apps.
